frequentlyAskedQuestionsDesc: Everything you need to know about becoming a provider
faq1A: You can showcase your skills and experience in your profile. Some services may require verification of credentials.
faq2Q: How much does it cost to join?
faq2A: Creating an account and listing your services is free. A platform commission is charged on completed bookings.
faq3A: Payments are processed after the customer confirms job completion and the pending period ends.
faqWhoCanBecomeAns: Anyone with a skill or service to offer can become a provider. Simply sign up, create your profile, and start listing your services.
faqHowToList: How do I list my services?
faqHowToListAns: After signing up as a provider, you can create service listings from your dashboard. Add descriptions, pricing, and photos to attract customers.
faqHowReceiveEarnings: How do I receive my earnings?
faqHowReceiveEarningsAns: Earnings are deposited into your linked bank account or digital wallet after each completed booking, following the pending period.
faqCommissionAns: Sewalo charges a small platform fee on each completed booking. The exact percentage is displayed before you confirm a service.
readyToGrowDesc: Join thousands of providers who are already earning on Sewalo. Sign up today and start offering your services.
